mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation (type, map_id, place_id, created_at) VALUES (#{type}, #{mapId}, #{placeId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, type, map_id, place_id, created_at FROM conversation WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.type, c.map_id, c.place_id, c.created_at FROM conversation c INNER JOIN conversation_member m1 ON m1.conversation_id = c.id AND m1.user_id = #{userIdA} INNER JOIN conversation_member m2 ON m2.conversation_id = c.id AND m2.user_id = #{userIdB} WHERE c.type = 'PRIVATE' ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 1
SELECT id, type, map_id, place_id, created_at FROM conversation WHERE type = 'GROUP' AND map_id = #{mapId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT id, type, map_id, place_id, created_at FROM conversation WHERE type = 'PLACE' AND place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
